# Apex-authored material availability baseline for the P2CE corpus (510 instance VMFs).
# 201 unique side materials; 192 resolve to a shader and an on-disk base VTF.

# and toolsinvisibleladder. These are content gaps, not parser errors.

# shader-specific inputs instead of $basetexture; all three use the placeholder
# until their rendering features are implemented. No proprietary files copied.
